run_load_game: run pyspiel.load_game to load a game by name such as negotiation
create_new_initial_state: create a new initial game state using game.new_initial_state()
run_apply_action: run state.apply_action to apply an action to the game state
run_get_item_pool: run state.item_pool to retrieve the item pool from the game state
run_get_agent_utils: run state.agent_utils to retrieve utility values for a specific player
